questions.text:
'प्रबंध लोगों की ताकत को प्रभावी बनाकर एवं उनकी कमज़ोरियों को अप्रासंगिक बनाकर उनसे संगठन के उद्देश्यों की प्राप्ति के लिए काम कराता है।'
उपर्युक्त चर्चित प्रबंध का आयाम है :
questions.text_english:
'The task of management is to make people work towards achieving the organisational goals, by making their strengths effective and their weaknesses irrelevant.'
The dimension of management discussed above is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Management of people. The statement emphasizes making people's strengths effective and weaknesses irrelevant to achieve organisational goals — this precisely describes the 'management of people' dimension. Management of work (A) refers to task completion, and management of operations (C) refers to production-related activities, neither of which is the focus of the statement. Option (D) is therefore also incorrect.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) लोगों का प्रबंध है। कथन में लोगों की ताकत को प्रभावी बनाकर और कमज़ोरियों को अप्रासंगिक बनाकर उद्देश्य प्राप्त करने की बात की गई है, जो 'लोगों के प्रबंध' के आयाम को दर्शाता है।

questions.text:
'प्रबंध श्रेष्ठ गुणवत्ता वाली वस्तुओं एवं सेवाओं को उपलब्ध कराने, रोज़गार के सुअवसरों का सृजन करने, लोगों के भले के लिए नई तकनीकों को अपनाने तथा वृद्धि एवं विकास के रास्ते पर चलने में सहायता करता है।'
उपर्युक्त में प्रबंध के महत्त्व के जिस बिन्दु पर प्रकाश डाला गया है, वह है :
questions.text_english:
'Management helps in providing good quality products and services, creates employment opportunities, adopts new technology for the greater good of the people and leads to the path towards growth and development.'
The point of importance of management highlighted above is :

options.A: प्रबंध सामूहिक लक्ष्यों की प्राप्ति में सहायता करता है।
options.B: प्रबंध कार्यकुशलता में वृद्धि करता है।
options.C: प्रबंध व्यक्तिगत उद्देश्यों की प्राप्ति में सहायता करता है।
options.D: प्रबंध समाज के विकास में सहायता करता है।

options_english.A: Management helps in achieving group goals.
options_english.C: Management helps in achieving personal objectives.
options_english.D: Management helps in development of society.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Management helps in development of society. The statement speaks about quality products, employment generation, new technology for the greater good of people, and growth — all of which are societal benefits. This directly points to how management contributes to society's development. Options A, B, and C refer to group goals, efficiency, and personal objectives respectively, none of which fully captures the societal dimension highlighted in the passage.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) प्रबंध समाज के विकास में सहायता करता है। कथन में समाज के लिए गुणवत्तापूर्ण वस्तुएँ, रोज़गार, नई तकनीक और विकास की बात की गई है, जो समाज के विकास में प्रबंध की भूमिका को दर्शाती है।

questions.text: 'व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण में विशिष्ट एवं साधारण दोनों शक्तियाँ सम्मिलित होती हैं।' निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी शक्ति विशिष्ट शक्तियों में सम्मिलित नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: 'Business Environment includes both specific and general forces.' Which of the following force is not included in specific forces ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Legal conditions. Specific forces in the business environment are those that directly and immediately affect a particular business, such as investors (B), competitors (C), and suppliers (D). Legal conditions are part of the general environment (also called the macro environment), which affects all businesses in the economy rather than any specific firm. Therefore, legal conditions are not included in specific forces.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) कानूनी शर्तें है। विशिष्ट शक्तियाँ वे होती हैं जो किसी विशेष व्यवसाय को सीधे प्रभावित करती हैं जैसे निवेशक, प्रतियोगी, आपूर्तिकर्ता। कानूनी शर्तें सामान्य पर्यावरण का हिस्सा हैं, न कि विशिष्ट शक्तियों का।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए :
कथन I : संगठन एक ऐसी प्रक्रिया है जिसके द्वारा उपक्रम के कार्यों को परिभाषित एवं वर्गीकृत किया जाता है और उन्हें विभिन्न व्यक्तियों को सौंपकर उनके अधिकार सम्बन्धों को निश्चित किया जाता है।
कथन II : इच्छित लक्ष्यों की प्राप्ति हेतु संगठन प्रक्रिया में कुछ कदमों की श्रृंखला को ध्यान में रखना आवश्यक है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों के आलोक में, नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully :
Statement I : Organising is the process of defining and grouping the activities of the enterprise and establishing authority relationships among them.
Statement II : Process of organising involves a series of steps that need to be taken in order to achieve the desired goals.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct alternative from the options given below :

options.A: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों सत्य हैं।
options.B: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों असत्य हैं।
options.C: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.D: कथन I असत्य है तथा कथन II सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options_english.B: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.
options_english.C: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.D: Statement I is false and Statement II is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Both Statement I and Statement II are true. Statement I correctly defines organising as the process of defining, grouping activities, and establishing authority relationships — this is the standard textbook definition. Statement II is also correct because organising follows a sequence of steps: identification of activities, grouping, assignment of duties, delegation of authority, and coordination. Both statements are factually accurate, so option A is the right choice.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों सत्य हैं। कथन I संगठन की सही परिभाषा देता है और कथन II संगठन की प्रक्रिया में चरणों की श्रृंखला का सही उल्लेख करता है। अतः दोनों कथन सत्य हैं।

questions.text:
'यह आश्वस्त करने के लिए कि उद्देश्यों की प्राप्ति हो रही है योजनाओं की निगरानी महत्त्वपूर्ण है' यह नियोजन प्रक्रिया के विभिन्न चरणों में से एक है।
निम्नलिखित में से चरण की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
'Monitoring plans is important to ensure that objectives are achieved' is one of the steps in the process of planning.
Identify the step from the following :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Follow-up action. In the planning process, after a plan is implemented, it is essential to monitor and review whether the plan is working as intended and if objectives are being achieved. This step is called 'follow-up action' or 'अनुवर्तन'. Setting objectives (A) is the first step, developing premises (B) involves forecasting, and implementing the plan (C) is about execution — none of these involve monitoring to ensure objective achievement.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) अनुवर्तन है। नियोजन प्रक्रिया में योजना लागू करने के बाद यह देखना कि उद्देश्यों की प्राप्ति हो रही है या नहीं, 'अनुवर्तन' चरण कहलाता है।

questions.text:
कालम I में दिए गए योजना के प्रकार का कालम II में दिए गए उनके अर्थ से मिलान कीजिए।
निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Match the type of plan given in Column I with its meaning given in Column II.
Choose the correct option from the following :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) 1-(iii), 2-(iv), 3-(ii), 4-(i). Policy (1) is a general statement guiding thinking or channelising energies in a specific direction — matching (iii). Procedure (2) consists of routine steps on how to carry out activities — matching (iv). Programme (3) is a detailed statement about a project outlining objectives, resources, and budget — matching (ii). Strategy (4) is a comprehensive plan for accomplishing organisational objectives — matching (i). All other options have incorrect pairings.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) 1-(iii), 2-(iv), 3-(ii), 4-(i) है। नीति एक सामान्य मार्गदर्शक कथन है (iii), प्रक्रिया दैनिक कार्य-गतिविधियाँ हैं (iv), कार्यक्रम परियोजना का विस्तृत विवरण है (ii), और व्यूह-रचना व्यापक योजना है (i)।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों : अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) को पढ़िए।
अभिकथन (A) : विपणन मात्र उत्पादन के बाद की क्रिया है।
कारण (R) : विपणन में उपभोक्ता की आवश्यकताओं की पहचान करना, उत्पाद के विकास के लिए सूचना एकत्रित करना, उपयुक्त उत्पाद पैकेज का रूपांकन करना तथा इसे ब्राण्ड नाम देने जैसी क्रियाएँ सम्मिलित हैं।
नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements : Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A) : Marketing is only a post production activity.
Reason (R) : Marketing includes activities like identification of customer needs, collection of information for developing the product, designing suitable product package and giving it a brand name.
Choose the correct alternative from the options given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों असत्य हैं।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are false.
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true. The Assertion that marketing is 'only' a post-production activity is incorrect. Marketing begins well before production — it involves identifying customer needs, market research, and product planning. The Reason (R) correctly describes marketing activities that occur both before and after production, proving that marketing is not limited to post-production. Since A is false but R is true, option D is correct.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। अभिकथन (A) गलत है क्योंकि विपणन केवल उत्पादन के बाद की क्रिया नहीं है बल्कि उत्पादन से पहले भी उपभोक्ता आवश्यकताओं की पहचान आदि की जाती है। कारण (R) सत्य है।

questions.text: रमेश तथा हरीश अच्छे दोस्त हैं, दोनों महिलाओं के लिए डिजाइनर कपड़े बनाने वाली एक कम्पनी 'अनुजा गारमेंट्स लिमिटेड' में कार्यरत हैं। रमेश विपणन विभाग में कार्य करता है और उसका उद्देश्य 15% छूट देकर बिक्री को बढ़ाना है। लेकिन हरीश, जो वित्त प्रबंधक है इस छूट के लिए अनुमति नहीं दे रहा क्योंकि इसका अर्थ कम्पनी के आगम में हानि है। इस प्रकार का द्वंद्व उन संगठनों में उत्पन्न होता है जहाँ प्रत्येक विभाग दूसरे विभाग से अलग होकर क्रियाओं का निष्पादन करता है। ऐसी समस्याओं के समाधान के लिए, विभिन्न विभागों की क्रियाओं को एक-दूसरे से जोड़ने की आवश्यकता है। प्रबंध की वह अवधारणा जो विभिन्न विभागों के प्रयासों को तथा विभिन्न स्तरों पर एकीकृत करती है, वह है :
questions.text_english: Ramesh and Harish are best friends, both working at 'Anuja Garments Ltd.', a company manufacturing designer clothing for women. Ramesh works in the marketing department and aims to increase the sales by 15% by offering discounts. However, Harish, the finance manager is not giving approval for this discount as it would mean loss of revenue for the company. This kind of conflict arises in organisations where each department performs activities in isolation from the other. To resolve such issues, there is a need for linking the activities of various departments. The concept of management which integrates the efforts of different departments, and at different levels, is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Coordination. Coordination is the management concept that integrates the efforts of different departments and individuals at all levels to achieve organisational goals. In this case, the conflict between the marketing and finance departments arises due to lack of coordination. Efficiency (A) relates to doing work with minimum resources, Effectiveness (B) means achieving targets, and Controlling (C) involves monitoring performance — none of these specifically integrates departmental efforts the way coordination does.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) समन्वय है। समन्वय वह प्रबंधकीय अवधारणा है जो विभिन्न विभागों के प्रयासों को एकीकृत करती है। विपणन और वित्त विभाग के बीच का यह द्वंद्व समन्वय की कमी के कारण है।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों : अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) को पढ़िए।
अभिकथन (A) : प्रशिक्षण से कर्मचारी की उत्पादकता में, गुणवत्ता एवं मात्रा दोनों के संदर्भ में वृद्धि होती है जिससे संगठन उच्च लाभों की ओर अग्रसर होता है।
कारण (R) : प्रशिक्षण एक व्यवस्थित अधिगम है जो सदैव बेहतर होता है, क्योंकि बार-बार गलती करके सीखने वाली विधियाँ बिना व्यवस्थित अधिगम के पैसा और प्रयासों दोनों की बर्बादी का कारण बनती हैं।
नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements : Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A) : Training enhances employee productivity, both in terms of quality and quantity, leading to high profits for the organisation.
Reason (R) : Training is a systematic learning which is always better, as hit and trial methods without systematic learning lead to wastage of efforts and money.
Choose the correct alternative from the options given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों असत्य हैं।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are false.
options_english.B: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.C: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.D: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A). Assertion A is true — training does enhance employee productivity in both quality and quantity, leading to higher profits. Reason R is also true — training is systematic learning and is superior to hit-and-trial methods that waste time and money. Moreover, Reason R correctly explains why training improves productivity, making C the right choice.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। अभिकथन (A) सत्य है — प्रशिक्षण से उत्पादकता बढ़ती है। कारण (R) भी सत्य है — प्रशिक्षण एक व्यवस्थित अधिगम है जो बार-बार गलती करके सीखने से बेहतर है। कारण (R) अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या भी करता है।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए :
कथन I : कार्यभार विश्लेषण विभिन्न कार्यों के निष्पादन के लिए कितनी संख्या में तथा किस प्रकार के मानव संसाधन उपलब्ध हैं, के निर्धारण को संभव बनाता है।
कथन II : कार्य-शक्ति विश्लेषण विभिन्न कार्यों के निष्पादन के लिए आवश्यक मानव संसाधनों की संख्या एवं प्रकार को प्रकट करता है।
उपर्युक्त कथनों के आलोक में, नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully :
Statement I : Workload analysis would enable an assessment of the number and types of human resources available for the performance of various jobs.
Statement II : Workforce analysis would reveal the number and types of human resources necessary for the performance of various jobs.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct alternative from the options given below :

options.A: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों सत्य हैं।
options.B: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों असत्य हैं।
options.C: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.D: कथन I असत्य है तथा कथन II सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options_english.B: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.
options_english.C: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.D: Statement I is false and Statement II is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) Statement I is false and Statement II is true. Workload analysis determines the number and types of human resources required (needed) for various jobs, not the ones available. Workforce analysis reveals the human resources currently available in the organisation. So Statement I has swapped the definitions — it describes workforce analysis, not workload analysis. Statement II correctly describes workforce analysis. Therefore, Statement I is false and Statement II is true.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) कथन I असत्य है तथा कथन II सत्य है। कार्यभार विश्लेषण आवश्यक मानव संसाधनों की जरूरत बताता है, उपलब्धता नहीं। कार्य-शक्ति विश्लेषण उपलब्ध मानव संसाधनों की संख्या प्रकट करता है। अतः कथन I में परिभाषाएँ उलट गई हैं।

questions.text_english: ____________ is the instrument, which is traded in Money Market.
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Commercial paper. The money market deals in short-term financial instruments (maturity of less than one year). Commercial paper is a short-term, unsecured promissory note issued by large corporations to meet short-term financial needs and is traded in the money market. Equity shares (A), Debentures (B), and Bonds (D) are capital market instruments with longer maturity periods and are not traded in the money market.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) वाणिज्यिक पेपर है। मुद्रा बाज़ार में अल्पकालीन वित्तीय साधनों का व्यापार होता है। वाणिज्यिक पेपर एक अल्पकालीन असुरक्षित वचन-पत्र है जो बड़ी कम्पनियाँ जारी करती हैं। समता अंश, ऋणपत्र और बाण्ड पूँजी बाज़ार के साधन हैं।

questions.text: इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप में प्रतिभूतियों को रखने की प्रक्रिया जानी जाती है :
questions.text_english: The process of holding securities in an electronic form is known as :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Dematerialization. Dematerialization is the process of converting physical share certificates and securities into electronic form, which are then held in a demat account. Rolling settlement (A) refers to the settlement cycle of trades, Registration (B) is the process of recording ownership, and Depository (D) is the institution that holds securities in electronic form — not the process itself. The process of holding securities electronically is specifically called dematerialization.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) विभौतिकीकरण (डीमैटेरियलाइजेशन) है। प्रतिभूतियों को भौतिक प्रमाण-पत्र से इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप में बदलने की प्रक्रिया को विभौतिकीकरण कहते हैं। निक्षेपागार वह संस्था है जो इन्हें रखती है, न कि प्रक्रिया।

questions.text:
'यदि अंशधारी सामान्यत: यह चाहते हैं कि कम-से-कम एक निश्चित राशि का भुगतान लाभांश के रूप में किया जाए, तो कम्पनियाँ इस लाभांश की घोषणा कर देती हैं।'
उपर्युक्त कथन, निम्नलिखित में से लाभांश निर्णय को प्रभावित करने वाले किस घटक पर प्रकाश डाल रहा है ?
questions.text_english:
'If the shareholders in general desire that at least a certain amount is paid as dividend, the companies are likely to declare the same.'
The above statement highlights which of the following factors affecting dividend decision ?
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Shareholders' Preference. The statement explicitly says that if shareholders desire a certain minimum dividend, the company is likely to declare it. This directly reflects the factor of shareholders' preference influencing the dividend decision. Amount of earning (A) relates to company profits, stability of earnings (C) refers to consistency of profits, and stability of dividends (D) refers to the company's policy of maintaining a steady dividend — none of these match the shareholder desire aspect in the statement.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) अंशधारियों की प्राथमिकता है। कथन में स्पष्ट है कि अंशधारियों की इच्छा के अनुसार कम्पनी लाभांश की घोषणा करती है, जो अंशधारियों की प्राथमिकता घटक को दर्शाता है।

questions.text: वस्तुओं एवं सेवाओं का क्रय, उपयोग एवं उपभोग करते समय एक उपभोक्ता के उत्तरदायित्व के सम्बन्ध में निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कथन ग़लत है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following statement is incorrect in respect of responsibility of a consumer while purchasing, using and consuming goods and services ?

options.A: खाद्य उत्पादों को क्रय करने से पूर्व आईएसआई मार्क की जाँच कीजिए।
options.B: वस्तुओं और सेवाओं को क्रय करते समय नगद-रसीद माँगें।
options.C: मूल्य, शुद्ध वज़न, उत्पादन एवं उपभोग करने की अंतिम तिथि, आदि की सूचना के लिए लेबल को ध्यान से पढ़ें।
options.D: यह सुनिश्चित करने पर बल दें कि आपका सौदा संतोषजनक रहे।

options_english.A: Check ISI mark on food products before buying.
options_english.B: Ask for a cash-memo on purchase of goods and services.
options_english.C: Read labels carefully so as to have information about prices, net weight, manufacturing and expiry dates, etc.
options_english.D: Assert yourself to ensure that you get a fair deal.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A). The statement asks for ISI mark on food products, but ISI mark (now BIS mark) is applicable to industrial products, not food products. Food products require FSSAI certification or Agmark. Asking for an ISI mark on food products is therefore incorrect. Options B, C, and D are all valid consumer responsibilities — asking for receipts, reading labels, and asserting yourself for a fair deal are all duties that a responsible consumer should follow.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। खाद्य उत्पादों पर आईएसआई मार्क नहीं होता; यह औद्योगिक उत्पादों के लिए होता है। खाद्य उत्पादों के लिए FSSAI या एगमार्क होता है। अतः यह कथन ग़लत है।

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए चित्र में प्रदर्शित भर्ती के बाह्य स्रोत को पहचानिए :
questions.text_english: Identify the external source of recruitment displayed in the picture given below :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) Advertisement. The image shows a job portal website (JobsHiJobs.com), which is an online platform where companies advertise job vacancies to attract candidates from outside the organisation. Advertising job vacancies through newspapers, websites, and job portals is a major external source of recruitment. Web publishing (C) is close but the image specifically shows a job advertisement platform, making Advertisement the most appropriate answer.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) विज्ञापन है। चित्र में एक जॉब पोर्टल वेबसाइट दिखाई गई है जो कम्पनियों द्वारा रिक्त पदों के विज्ञापन का माध्यम है। यह भर्ती का एक महत्त्वपूर्ण बाह्य स्रोत है।

questions.text:
'एबीसी लिमिटेड' एक बड़ी बहुराष्ट्रीय कम्पनी है जिसमें प्रत्येक विभाग में लगभग 1000 कर्मचारी हैं। कम्पनी में पाँच विभाग हैं। इस संगठन में, कर्मचारियों के अवकाश प्रार्थना-पत्रों की स्वीकृति विभागीय अध्यक्षों द्वारा की जाती थी। प्रत्येक विभाग में बड़ी संख्या में अवकाश प्रार्थना-पत्रों के कारण इसकी स्वीकृति में देरी होती थी। इस कारण कर्मचारियों के बीच अत्यधिक असन्तोष की स्थिति थी। इस समस्या के समाधान के लिए, संगठन के मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी ने सभी विभागीय अध्यक्षों की एक सभा (मीटिंग) बुलाई। यह निर्णय लिया गया कि सभी स्तरों के प्रबंधकों को 10 दिन तक के अवकाश प्रार्थना-पत्रों की स्वीकृति का कार्य सौंप दिया जाए। यह भी निर्णय लिया गया कि इसे सम्पूर्ण संगठन में निम्नतम स्तर तक सौंपा जाए। चूँकि निर्णयन अधिकार को निम्न स्तरों तक विभाजित किया गया था तथा उसे वास्तविक कार्य बिन्दु के समीप रखा गया था, वे उच्च स्तरीय अनुमति की आवश्यकता के बिना ही अवकाश प्रार्थना-पत्रों को स्वीकृत अथवा अस्वीकृत कर सकते थे। नीति में परिवर्तन के बाद, सभी स्तरों के कर्मचारियों ने अवकाश प्रार्थना-पत्रों की स्वीकृति में सुधार देखा।
प्रबंध की वह अवधारणा जिससे अवकाश की स्वीकृति में गति एवं लोचशीलता में सुधार आया, वह थी :
questions.text_english:
'ABC Ltd.', a large multinational company had approximately 1000 employees in each of its departments. The company had five departments. In this organisation, leave applications of the employees had to be approved by the departmental heads. This approval is delayed due to large number of leave applications in each department. This led to a lot of dissatisfaction amongst the employees. To resolve this problem, the Chief Executive Officer of the organisation called a meeting of all departmental heads. It was decided to assign the approval of leave applications up to 10 days to the managers at all levels. It was also decided that it will be assigned till the lowest level throughout the organisation. Since the decision-making authority was shared with lower levels and placed nearest to the point of action, they could approve or deny leave applications without requiring higher level approval. After the policy change, employees at all levels noticed an improvement in the sanctioning of leave applications.
The concept of management which led to an improvement in the speed and flexibility of leave approval is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Decentralisation. The case describes spreading decision-making authority to the lowest level throughout the organisation so that managers at all levels could approve leave independently. This is the definition of decentralisation — systematic dispersal of authority to lower levels. Delegation (B) is sharing authority with one subordinate, not throughout the organisation at all levels. Organising (A) is the process of establishing structure, and authority (D) is just a concept, not the action being described.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) विकेन्द्रीकरण है। संगठन में सम्पूर्ण स्तरों पर निर्णयन अधिकार बाँटना विकेन्द्रीकरण है। अंतरण में केवल एक अधीनस्थ को अधिकार सौंपा जाता है, पूरे संगठन में नहीं।

questions.text:
'एक्सवाईज़ैड लिमिटेड' इस नए तकनीकी युग में भी कर्मचारियों की उपस्थिति का रिकार्ड रखने के लिए रजिस्टरों का उपयोग कर रही है। मानव संसाधन प्रबंधक कर्मचारियों के बेईमान व्यवहार के कारण समस्याओं का सामना कर रहा है क्योंकि वे ग़लत कार्य घंटे लिख रहे हैं। इतना ही नहीं, उत्पादन प्रबंधक भी प्रतिदिन कच्चे माल की चोरी के बारे में सूचित कर रहा है। इस प्रकार की समस्याओं का समाधान करने के लिए कम्पनी ने बायोमैट्रिक उपस्थिति विधि का प्रयोग करना आरम्भ कर दिया तथा कर्मचारियों की गतिविधियों पर ध्यान रखने के लिए महत्त्वपूर्ण स्थानों पर कैमरे लगा दिए। इससे काफ़ी हद तक कर्मचारियों के बेईमान व्यवहार को कम करने में मदद मिली।
उपर्युक्त स्थिति में नियन्त्रण के महत्त्व के जिस बिन्दु पर प्रकाश डाला गया है, वह है :
questions.text_english:
'XYZ Ltd.' is using registers to record attendance of the employees even in this new tech era. The Human Resource Manager is facing problems due to the dishonest behaviour of employees as they are writing wrong working hours. Not only this, the Production Manager is also reporting about the theft of raw materials every day. To resolve these types of problems, the company started using biometric attendance system and installed cameras at important areas to keep an eye on the activities of the employees. This helped in reducing dishonest behaviour of the employees to a large extent.
The point of importance of controlling highlighted in the above case is :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Ensuring order and discipline. The case highlights that employees were behaving dishonestly by writing wrong working hours and stealing raw materials. The company used biometric systems and cameras to monitor and control such behaviour. This directly demonstrates the importance of controlling in ensuring order and discipline in the workplace. While efficient use of resources (C) may be an indirect benefit, the primary focus here is on preventing misconduct and maintaining discipline.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) आदेश और अनुशासन की सुनिश्चितता है। कर्मचारियों के बेईमान व्यवहार को नियन्त्रित करने के लिए बायोमैट्रिक और कैमरे लगाना अनुशासन सुनिश्चित करने का उदाहरण है।

questions.text:
वीना को अपने पिताजी से ₹ 40 लाख उपहार में मिले। वह अपने भाई के साथ अपने पैसे को निवेश करने के विभिन्न अवसरों पर चर्चा कर रही थी। उसने वीना को अपने पैसे मोरेसो लिमिटेड के अंशों में निवेश करने की सलाह दी, जो एक प्रतिष्ठित कम्पनी है। उसने आगे जोड़ा कि इससे दीर्घकाल में न केवल अच्छे लाभ उत्पन्न होंगे, अपितु जब भी आवश्यकता हो इसे आसानी से बेचा जा सकता है।
उपर्युक्त स्थिति में वीना के भाई द्वारा शेयर बाज़ार के जिस कार्य पर प्रकाश डाला गया है, उसकी पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Veena received ₹ 40 lakhs as a gift from her father. She was discussing various avenues of investing her money with her brother. He advised Veena to invest her money in shares of Moreso Ltd., a reputed company. He further added that it would not only generate good returns over the long term, but could easily be sold whenever required.
Identify the function of stock exchange being highlighted by Veena's brother in the above case :

options.B: विद्यमान प्रतिभूतियों को तरलता एवं विनियोग उपलब्ध कराना
options.D: सट्टेबाज़ी के लिए अवसर उपलब्ध कराना

options_english.B: Providing liquidity and marketability to existing securities

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Providing liquidity and marketability to existing securities. The brother specifically mentioned that the shares can be easily sold whenever required. This refers to the function of the stock exchange that provides liquidity — meaning investors can convert their securities into cash quickly. Pricing of securities (A) relates to price discovery, safety of transactions (C) is about security of deals, and speculation (D) is not being referred to here.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) विद्यमान प्रतिभूतियों को तरलता एवं विनियोग उपलब्ध कराना है। भाई ने कहा कि जब भी जरूरत हो शेयर बेचे जा सकते हैं, जो शेयर बाज़ार की तरलता प्रदान करने की विशेषता को दर्शाता है।

questions.text:
'पायल लिमिटेड' सोलर पैनल का निर्माण प्रारंभ करने की योजना बना रहा है जिसके लिए इसे मशीनरी में एक बड़ी राशि निवेश करने की आवश्यकता होगी। ये जो मशीनरी क्रय करना चाहते हैं उसे हाल ही में बाज़ार में उतारा गया है। इससे न केवल प्रति इकाई लागत में कमी आएगी, अपितु इस व्यवसाय में पहले से ही विद्यमान अन्य सोलर पैनल निर्माताओं द्वारा उपयोग में लाई जाने वाली मशीनों की तुलना में उत्पादन भी दोगुना कर देगी।
'पायल लिमिटेड' के मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी ने वित्त प्रबंधक से उपर्युक्त मशीनरी क्रय करने के लिए कोष की आवश्यकताओं का पूर्वानुमान लगाने के लिए कहा ताकि यह सुनिश्चित हो सके कि उचित समय पर पर्याप्त धन उपलब्ध हो।
निम्नलिखित में से उस अवधारणा को पहचानिए जिसके बारे में मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी, वित्त प्रबंधक के साथ चर्चा कर रहा है :
questions.text_english:
'Payal Ltd.' plans to start manufacturing solar panels which will require a significant amount of investment in machinery. The machinery which they intend to purchase is newly launched in the market. It will not only reduce the cost per unit, but also double the production as compared to the machines used by other solar panel manufacturers already existing in this business.
The Chief Executive Officer of 'Payal Ltd.' asked the finance manager to forecast the fund requirements for purchasing the above machinery to ensure that enough funds are available at the right time.
From the following, identify the concept about which the Chief Executive Officer is discussing with the finance manager :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) Financial Planning. The CEO is asking the finance manager to forecast fund requirements in advance to ensure that adequate funds are available at the right time. This is the essence of financial planning — estimating future financial needs and ensuring their timely availability. Capital budgeting (A) involves evaluating long-term investment decisions, trading on equity (B) is about using debt to increase returns, and wealth maximisation (D) is a broad goal — none describe the forecasting of fund requirements as specifically as financial planning does.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) वित्तीय नियोजन है। CEO ने वित्त प्रबंधक से धन की आवश्यकताओं का पूर्वानुमान लगाने के लिए कहा, जो वित्तीय नियोजन का मुख्य कार्य है — भविष्य में वित्त की जरूरतों का अनुमान लगाना और उनकी समय पर उपलब्धता सुनिश्चित करना।

questions.text:

questions.text_english:
'Maira Electronics' is a manufacturer of smartphones and famous for its quality. It is a large organisation, so each and every piece produced cannot be checked. So the company made a policy that out of 500 smartphones produced a day, 20 smartphones would be randomly selected for a quality check.
Identify the step of controlling process discussed above :

options.C: मानकों एवं वास्तविक निष्पादन की तुलना

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) Measurement of actual performance. Randomly selecting 20 out of 500 smartphones for quality check is an act of measuring actual performance — the company is checking what is actually being produced against quality standards. Setting standards (A) would involve defining what quality level is acceptable, comparing (C) comes after measurement, and corrective action (D) follows if a deviation is found. The act of random selection and checking is specifically the measurement step.

sub_questions.text_english: Differentiate between 'Primary Market' and 'Secondary Market' on any three basis.

key_points: Meaning — Primary market deals in new securities; Secondary market deals in existing securities
Participants — In primary market, securities are sold directly by companies to investors; in secondary market, existing investors buy and sell among themselves
Price — In primary market, price is fixed by the company; in secondary market, price is determined by demand and supply

sub_questions.solution: Primary market and secondary market differ on the following three bases. First, regarding the type of securities: the primary market deals in new securities being issued for the first time by companies, while the secondary market deals in existing, previously issued securities. Second, regarding participants: in the primary market, securities flow directly from the company to investors, whereas in the secondary market, transactions take place between investors themselves. Third, regarding price determination: prices in the primary market are fixed by the issuing company, while in the secondary market, prices are determined by the forces of demand and supply on the stock exchange.

sub_questions.text_english: Differentiate between 'Capital Market' and 'Money Market' on the following basis : (i) Duration (ii) Liquidity (iii) Safety

key_points: Duration — Capital market deals in long-term instruments (more than one year); Money market deals in short-term instruments (less than one year)
Liquidity — Capital market instruments have lower liquidity; Money market instruments have higher liquidity
Safety — Capital market instruments carry higher risk; Money market instruments are relatively safer

sub_questions.solution: Capital Market and Money Market differ on the following three bases. First, duration: capital market deals in long-term financial instruments with a maturity period exceeding one year, while money market deals in short-term instruments with maturity of less than one year, such as treasury bills and commercial paper. Second, liquidity: money market instruments are highly liquid as they can be easily converted to cash, whereas capital market instruments have lower liquidity. Third, safety: money market instruments are considered relatively safer due to their short tenure, whereas capital market instruments carry higher risk due to market fluctuations and longer tenure.

गुणवत्ता एवं विशेषताओं के अतिरिक्त, उत्पाद-सम्बन्धी बहुत से महत्त्वपूर्ण निर्णयों की उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चा की गई है। ऐसे किन्हीं तीन निर्णयों को पहचानिए एवं उनका अर्थ बताइए।
questions.text_english:
Vani, after completing her course in 'Nutrition and Fitness', wanted to launch millet-based healthy snacks. She researched a lot and started manufacturing a range of healthy, crunchy millet namkeens and named them 'Pure Millets'. The name reflected natural ingredients, appealing to health-conscious consumers. The millet snacks were packaged in eco-friendly, bio-degradable packets with a reasonable feature, ensuring freshness and convenience. The stickers on the packets displayed the name with the tagline 'Power Your Health' and nutritional information and certifications like 'Organic Certified' to establish the product's health benefits. 'Pure Millets' got off to a good start.
In addition to features and quality, various other product-related important decisions are discussed in the above case. Identify and give the meaning of any three such decisions.

key_points: Branding — Giving the product a name ('Pure Millets') and tagline ('Power Your Health')
Packaging — Using eco-friendly, bio-degradable packets that ensure freshness and convenience
Labelling — Stickers displaying product name, tagline, nutritional information, and certifications like 'Organic Certified'
Branding — naming the product 'Pure Millets' and giving it a tagline
Packaging — eco-friendly bio-degradable packets ensuring freshness and convenience
Labelling — stickers showing nutritional information and organic certifications

questions.solution: Three product-related decisions discussed in the above case are as follows. First, Branding: Vani named her product 'Pure Millets' with the tagline 'Power Your Health'. Branding means giving a product a unique name, symbol, or design to distinguish it from competitors and create a distinct identity in the minds of consumers. Second, Packaging: The millet snacks were packed in eco-friendly, bio-degradable packets that ensured freshness and convenience. Packaging means designing the container or wrapper of a product that protects it and makes it attractive to consumers. Third, Labelling: The stickers on the packets displayed the product name, tagline, nutritional information, and certifications like 'Organic Certified'. Labelling refers to the printed information on the package that informs and educates the consumer about the product's contents, benefits, and usage.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following factors affecting the fixed capital requirements of a company : (i) Nature of Business (ii) Choice of Technique (iii) Growth Prospects

key_points: Nature of Business — manufacturing companies need more fixed capital than trading companies
Choice of Technique — capital-intensive production techniques require higher fixed capital
Growth Prospects — companies expecting high growth need to invest more in fixed assets in advance

sub_questions.solution: Three factors affecting fixed capital requirements are as follows. First, Nature of Business: manufacturing companies require heavy investment in plant, machinery, and equipment, and therefore need more fixed capital. Trading companies, on the other hand, need relatively less fixed capital since they do not manufacture goods. Second, Choice of Technique: companies using capital-intensive techniques of production (involving heavy machinery and automation) require more fixed capital compared to those using labour-intensive techniques. Third, Growth Prospects: companies that anticipate higher growth in the future need to invest more in fixed assets to expand production capacity. Therefore, high-growth companies tend to have larger fixed capital requirements.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following factors affecting financing decision of a company : (i) Fixed Operating Costs (ii) Control Considerations (iii) State of Capital Market

key_points: Fixed Operating Costs — companies with high fixed costs prefer less debt in their capital structure
Control Considerations — promoters who want to retain control prefer debt over equity
State of Capital Market — companies raise equity when markets are buoyant and debt when markets are depressed

sub_questions.solution: Three factors affecting a company's financing decision are as follows. First, Fixed Operating Costs: a company that already has high fixed operating costs tends to use less debt financing, since debt adds to fixed financial obligations. High fixed costs increase financial risk, so such companies prefer equity to debt. Second, Control Considerations: if existing shareholders wish to retain control over the company, they would prefer debt financing over issuing new equity shares, as equity dilutes ownership and control. Third, State of Capital Market: when the capital market is buoyant and investor confidence is high, companies prefer to raise funds through equity. When the market is bearish or depressed, they tend to rely more on debt financing.

'एसेंशियल लिमिटेड', एक कम्पनी है जिसमें 700 कर्मचारी कार्यरत हैं तथा जो पिछले 20 वर्षों से खाना पकाने के तेल के निर्माता हैं। बालों की देखभाल के उत्पादों की बढ़ती हुई माँग को देखते हुए, उन्होंने बालों को बढ़ाने के लिए एक अनोखा फार्मूला विकसित किया है जो गंजे लोगों के लिए भी उपयोगी है। वे इस फार्मूले को गोपनीय रखना चाहते हैं ताकि कम्पनी अपनी प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक बढ़त बनाए रखे। चूँकि वे बालों के तेल को तुरंत बाज़ार में लाना चाहते हैं, उन्हें विश्वसनीय लोगों की ज़रूरत है जिनका मूल्यांकन अत्यधिक शुद्धता के साथ किया जा सके और शीघ्रता से इस विशिष्ट विभाग में रखा जा सके। इसके लिए, मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी ने मानव संसाधन प्रबंधक कर्ण के साथ परामर्श किया। कर्ण ने सुझाव दिया कि ऐसे पाँच विश्वसनीय एवं मेहनती कर्मचारी हैं जो इस विशिष्ट विभाग के लिए उपयुक्त हैं। साथ ही, उत्पादन विभाग में ऐसे दो कर्मचारी हैं जिन्हें अधिक वेतन के साथ इस विभाग के प्रमुख का उत्तरदायित्व दिया जा सकता है। कम्पनी कर्मचारियों की अभिप्रेरणा, निष्ठा तथा उनके संतुष्टि स्तर को बढ़ाने के लिए प्रतिबद्ध है।

questions.text_english:
'Essential Ltd.' is a company that has been manufacturing cooking oil for the past 20 years and 700 employees are working in it. Recognising the growing demand for hair care products, they developed a unique formula for hair growth useful even for people who are bald. They want to keep the formula confidential to maintain a competitive edge. As they plan to immediately launch the hair oil in the market, they needed reliable people who could be evaluated more accurately and be placed in this specialised department quickly. For this, the Chief Executive Officer consulted the Human Resource Manager, Karn. Karn suggested that there are five reliable and hard-working employees who will be a good fit for this specialised department. Also, there are two employees in the production department to whom they can give the responsibility of heading this department with higher pay. The company is committed to improve motivation, loyalty and satisfaction level of employees.
Explain any two sources of recruitment discussed above which will help 'Essential Ltd.' to recruit reliable people in this specialised department.

key_points: Transfer — moving existing employees from one department to another
Promotion — elevating existing employees to higher positions with more responsibility and better pay

questions.solution: The two internal sources of recruitment discussed in the case are as follows. First, Transfer: Karn suggested that five reliable and hard-working employees from within the organisation could be transferred to the new specialised department. Transfer means moving an employee from one department or location to another at the same level, without a change in designation or pay. Since the company already knows these employees well, their reliability and performance can be assessed accurately. Second, Promotion: Karn also suggested that two employees from the production department could be given the responsibility of heading the new department with higher pay. Promotion refers to shifting an employee to a higher position with greater responsibilities, enhanced status, and better remuneration. This also boosts motivation, loyalty, and satisfaction, which aligns with the company's stated commitment.

questions.text:
'एके लिमिटेड', एक बड़ी कम्पनी है जिसमें 4000 कर्मचारी भारतीय रसोई में उपयोग किए जाने वाली विस्तृत किस्मों के मसालों के उत्पादन में संलग्न हैं। कम्पनी कर्मचारियों द्वारा की जा रही अनुचित माँगों और बार-बार हड़ताल पर जाने के दृढ़ मुद्दों से निरन्तर संघर्ष कर रही है। इस मुद्दे के समाधान के लिए मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी ने एक प्रबंध-विशेषज्ञ की नियुक्ति की, जो स्थिति का विश्लेषण करेगा और समस्या के समाधान के लिए सुझाव देगा। प्रबंध-विशेषज्ञ ने स्थिति का विश्लेषण किया और समस्या के समाधान के लिए सुझाव दिया कि टेलर के वैज्ञानिक प्रबंध के सिद्धान्त का अनुसरण किया जाए जिसमें प्रबंध एवं कर्मचारियों दोनों में सम्पूर्ण मानसिक क्रान्ति का सुझाव दिया गया है। इसका अर्थ है कि प्रबंध एवं कर्मचारी दोनों की सोच में बदलाव आए जहाँ श्रम संगठन (मज़दूर-संघ) भी हड़ताल पर जाने के बारे में न सोचें। यह इस बात पर बल देता है कि प्रबन्धकों की समृद्धि, कर्मचारियों की समृद्धि के बिना लम्बे समय तक नहीं रह सकती और इसके विपरीत कर्मचारियों की समृद्धि भी प्रबंधकों की समृद्धि के बिना अधिक समय तक नहीं रह सकती।
(i) प्रबंध-विशेषज्ञ द्वारा उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चित प्रबंध के वैज्ञानिक सिद्धान्त को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
(ii) टेलर द्वारा सुझाए गए एक और सिद्धान्त को भी समझाइए, जो उपर्युक्त (i) में पहचाने गए सिद्धान्त का विस्तार है।
questions.text_english:
'AK Ltd.' is a large company with 4000 workers engaged in production of wide varieties of spices used in the Indian kitchen. The company has been struggling with a persistent issue of workers making unreasonable demands and going on strike frequently. To address the issue, the Chief Executive Officer appointed a management expert who will analyse the situation and suggest solutions to overcome the problem. The management expert analysed the situation and suggested that the company could resolve the issue by following Taylor's principle of Scientific Management which suggested complete mental revolution on the part of both management and workers. It means that management and workers should transform their thinking, where even trade unions will not think of going on strike. It emphasises that prosperity of the employer cannot exist for a long time unless it is accompanied by the prosperity for the employees and vice versa.
(i) Identify and explain the principle of Scientific Management discussed in the above case by the management expert.
(ii) Also, explain another principle suggested by Taylor, which is an extension of the principle identified in (i) above.

sub_questions.text: प्रबंध-विशेषज्ञ द्वारा उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चित प्रबंध के वैज्ञानिक सिद्धान्त को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify and explain the principle of Scientific Management discussed in the above case by the management expert.

key_points: Principle: Mental Revolution
Explanation: Both management and workers should completely change their attitude towards each other — instead of conflict, there should be cooperation and mutual prosperity

sub_questions.solution: The principle identified is Mental Revolution. Taylor's principle of Mental Revolution requires a complete transformation in the attitude and outlook of both management and workers towards each other. Instead of fighting over the division of profits, both parties should focus on increasing the total output so that there is enough for everyone. Management should care for workers' welfare and workers should work sincerely and productively. Trade unions should not think of going on strike and management should not think of cutting wages. The underlying belief is that the prosperity of the employer and the employees are interdependent and cannot be sustained independently.

sub_questions.text: टेलर द्वारा सुझाए गए एक और सिद्धान्त को भी समझाइए, जो उपर्युक्त (i) में पहचाने गए सिद्धान्त का विस्तार है।
sub_questions.text_english: Also, explain another principle suggested by Taylor, which is an extension of the principle identified in (i) above.

key_points: Principle: Harmony, Not Discord
Explanation: Management and workers should work in harmony, not in conflict; cooperation and coordination should replace confrontation

sub_questions.solution: The principle which is an extension of Mental Revolution is Harmony, Not Discord. Taylor believed that there should be complete harmony between the management and workers in the organisation. Both parties should realise that they need each other — management needs workers for production and workers need management for wages and welfare. Taylor advocated replacing conflict with cooperation and mutual trust. He suggested that management should take interest in workers' welfare and workers should give their best to the organisation. This principle goes a step further than mental revolution by converting the changed attitude into active, cooperative working relationships.

'ओमारा लिमिटेड' एक वस्त्र निर्माण कम्पनी है जो जैविक, पुनर्नवीनीकरण तथा टिकाऊ सामग्री से जैकेटों का उत्पादन कर रही है। पर्यावरण अनुकूल कपड़ों के स्रोतीकरण, धीमी उत्पादन प्रक्रिया तथा नैतिक श्रम प्रथाओं पर केन्द्रित होने के कारण कपड़ों की प्राप्ति और उनको जैकेटों में परिवर्तित करने के बीच बड़ा समय अन्तराल होता है। चूँकि 'ओमारा लिमिटेड' वस्त्र उद्योग में अत्यधिक प्रतिस्पर्धा का सामना कर रही है, इसे उपभोक्ताओं के तत्काल आदेशों की पूर्ति के लिए जैकेटों का विशाल भण्डारण करना पड़ता है। उपभोक्ताओं को और अधिक आकर्षित करने और बनाए रखने के लिए 'ओमारा लिमिटेड' उन्हें उदार उधार की शर्तें भी प्रस्तावित करती है। इस प्रकार 'ओमारा लिमिटेड' अपने प्रतिस्पर्धियों की तुलना में अधिक बेहतर प्रदर्शन करने में सक्षम है।

'स्मार्ट एड्स' एक ई-वॉकिंग स्टिक (इलेक्ट्रॉनिक चलने वाली छड़ी) का निर्माण करने वाली प्रतिष्ठित कम्पनी थी। यह अब उन लोगों के लिए जिन्हें दृष्टि एवं गतिशीलता से जुड़ी समस्याएँ हैं, सुरक्षित एवं आसानी से घूमने के लिए सेंसर (संवेदक) और आवाज़ प्रतिक्रिया सहित ई-वॉकिंग स्टिक प्रदान कर रही है। कम्पनी अच्छे लाभ कमा रही है।
इसकी बड़ी सफलता के बाद, यह उच्च श्रेणी की स्मार्ट घड़ियों के निर्माण में प्रवेश करके विविधीकरण लाना चाहती है। ये स्मार्ट घड़ियाँ बुजुर्ग लोगों को (अपने प्रियजनों के साथ जुड़े रहकर) स्वतन्त्रापूर्वक एवं सुरक्षित रहने में मदद करेंगी। यह स्मार्ट घड़ियाँ आपातकालीन चेतावनी देकर, उन्हें दवा, आदि लेने की याद दिलाकर उनके स्वास्थ्य की निगरानी भी रखेंगी और उन्हें स्वास्थ्य सम्बन्धी समस्याओं का प्रबंधन करने में सहायता करेंगी। ये शारीरिक गतिविधियों के लिए प्रोत्साहित करेंगी तथा आसान उपयोग के लिए आवाज़ सहायक के रूप में कार्य करेंगी और कॉल्स तथा संदेशों के माध्यम से उन्हें अपने परिवार के साथ जोड़े रखेंगी।
यद्यपि दोनों उत्पादों में बहुत से कार्य एक जैसी प्रकृति के हैं, तथापि उन्होंने इन घड़ियों के लिए एक अलग व्यावसायिक इकाई स्थापित की है। दोनों इकाइयों के अलग-अलग प्रबंधक हैं जो अपनी-अपनी इकाइयों के निष्पादन के लिए उत्तरदायी हैं और उन पर उनका अधिकार है। प्रत्येक प्रबंधक अपनी इकाई के लाभों, आगमों एवं लागतों के लिए जवाबदेह है। इस प्रकार का संगठनात्मक ढाँचा संगठन के विद्यमान प्रचालनों में बिना कोई अवरोध किए नई इकाइयों को जोड़ने में सहायता करेगा।

(ii) संगठनात्मक ढाँचे के ऐसे किन्हीं दो लाभों का उल्लेख कीजिए, जिन पर उपर्युक्त स्थिति में प्रकाश डाला गया है।

'Smart Aids' was a reputed company manufacturing e-walking sticks. It is now providing e-walking sticks with sensors or voice feedback for helping people with vision or mobility issues to move around more safely and easily. The company has been earning good profits.
After its great success, it wants to diversify and enter into the manufacturing of high-class smart watches. These smart watches will help older people to live independently and safely while staying connected to their loved ones. These smart watches would also monitor their health by sending emergency alerts, reminding them to take medicines, etc. and help in managing their health issues. It will encourage physical activity and offer voice assistance for easy use and keep them connected with family through calls and messages.
Though there are very homogeneous functions in both the products, they set up a separate business unit for these watches. Both units will have separate managers responsible for the performance of their units and have authority over the unit. Each manager would be accountable for profits, revenues and costs of their unit. This type of organisational structure would help the organisation to add new units without interrupting the existing operations.
(i) State the type of organisational structure suitable for 'Smart Aids' giving reason in support of your answer.
(ii) Give two advantages of the organisational structure, which are highlighted in the above case.

sub_questions.text_english: State the type of organisational structure suitable for 'Smart Aids' giving reason in support of your answer.

key_points: Divisional Structure is suitable

sub_questions.solution: The suitable organisational structure for 'Smart Aids' is Divisional Structure. The reason is that the company has two different product lines — e-walking sticks and smart watches — each with its own separate business unit, manager, and accountability for profits, revenues, and costs. In a divisional structure, the organisation is divided into units based on products, each functioning as a semi-autonomous unit. This structure allows the company to add new product divisions without disturbing the existing operations, which is exactly what is described in the case.

key_points: Accountability — each divisional manager is accountable for profits, revenues, and costs of their unit, making performance evaluation easier
Flexibility — new divisions can be added without disturbing existing operations

sub_questions.solution: Two advantages of the divisional structure highlighted in the case are as follows. First, Accountability: each divisional manager is separately accountable for the profits, revenues, and costs of their own unit. This makes it easy to evaluate the performance of each division and identify which unit is doing well or poorly. Second, Flexibility to Expand: the divisional structure allows the organisation to add new business units or product lines without interrupting the existing operations. As stated in the case, Smart Aids can smoothly add the smart watch division without affecting the e-walking stick division.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following features of 'Management' : (i) Management is a dynamic function. (ii) Management is an intangible force.

key_points: Dynamic function — Management adapts to changing environment; it modifies its objectives, policies and strategies as per the business conditions
Intangible force — Management cannot be seen physically but its presence is felt through orderly functioning and achievement of goals

sub_questions.solution: The two features of management are as follows. First, Management is a Dynamic Function: management is not static; it continuously adapts to the changing business environment. As the social, economic, political, and technological conditions change, managers must modify their objectives, plans, strategies, and methods accordingly. For example, the shift to online work during the pandemic required organisations to adapt their management practices dynamically. Second, Management is an Intangible Force: management cannot be seen or touched like a physical object, yet its presence is strongly felt throughout the organisation. When management is effective, the organisation runs smoothly, goals are achieved, employees are motivated, and resources are used efficiently. Its impact is visible in the results, even though it remains invisible as a force.

sub_questions.text: 'प्रबंध के सिद्धान्तों' की निम्नलिखित विशेषताओं को समझाइए : (i) सामान्य मार्गदर्शन (ii) कारण एवं परिणाम के बीच सम्बन्ध
sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following features of 'Principles of Management' : (i) General guidelines (ii) Cause and Effect relationship

key_points: General guidelines — Principles of management provide broad frameworks for decision-making, not rigid rules
Cause and effect relationship — Principles establish a link between cause and its likely effect, helping managers predict outcomes

sub_questions.solution: The two features of principles of management are as follows. First, General Guidelines: principles of management do not prescribe a fixed course of action. They are general guidelines that help managers take decisions in a variety of situations. They are flexible and can be modified according to the specific circumstances of the organisation. For instance, the principle of division of work guides managers to specialise tasks, but how it is applied depends on the context. Second, Cause and Effect Relationship: principles of management establish a relationship between a cause and its effect. They tell managers what will likely happen if a certain action is taken. For example, if the principle of fair remuneration is violated (cause), it will lead to employee dissatisfaction and decreased productivity (effect). This helps managers anticipate outcomes and make informed decisions.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following principles of 'General Management' : (i) Division of work (ii) Unity of command

key_points: Division of Work — specialisation of tasks leads to efficiency and better output
Unity of Command — each employee should receive orders from only one superior to avoid confusion

sub_questions.solution: The two principles of General Management given by Henri Fayol are as follows. First, Division of Work: this principle states that the total work of an organisation should be divided into specific tasks and assigned to different people based on their specialisation. When a worker repeatedly performs the same task, they develop expertise and skill, which leads to increased efficiency, better quality output, and reduction in waste. For example, in a manufacturing unit, separate workers for welding, painting, and assembly produce better results than one person doing all tasks. Second, Unity of Command: this principle states that every employee in an organisation should receive orders and instructions from only one superior. If an employee receives commands from two or more managers, it creates confusion, conflict, and lack of discipline. Having a single authority above each employee ensures clarity, accountability, and smooth functioning of the organisation.

sub_questions.text: प्रबंध के सिद्धान्तों के महत्त्व के निम्नलिखित बिन्दुओं को समझाइए : (i) प्रबंधकों को वास्तविकता का उपयोगी सूक्ष्म ज्ञान प्रदान करना (ii) संसाधनों का अधिकतम उपयोग एवं प्रभावी प्रशासन
sub_questions.text_english: Explain the following points of importance of principles of management : (i) Providing managers with useful insights into reality (ii) Optimum utilisation of resources and effective administration

key_points: Providing insights — Principles improve managers' understanding of real-world situations and help them take better decisions
Optimum utilisation — Principles guide managers to use resources efficiently and administer effectively to achieve goals

sub_questions.solution: The two points of importance of principles of management are as follows. First, Providing Managers with Useful Insights into Reality: principles of management are based on practical experiences and observations, and they provide managers with a deeper understanding of managerial situations. Instead of relying only on intuition or trial and error, managers can apply proven principles to handle complex, real-world problems more effectively. This improves their judgment, helps them interpret situations accurately, and enables them to take better-informed decisions in various business scenarios. Second, Optimum Utilisation of Resources and Effective Administration: principles of management guide managers in making the best possible use of available resources — human, financial, physical, and informational. By applying principles like division of work, authority and responsibility, and discipline, managers can streamline operations, reduce wastage, improve coordination, and administer the organisation effectively to achieve its goals within the available means.

सारा ने प्रतिनिधि को बहुत बार पर्यवेक्षक से बात कराने के लिए कहा, लेकिन प्रतिनिधि ने हमेशा यही कहा कि वह उपलब्ध नहीं है। सारा निराश हो गई और वेबसाइट पर अपनी राय लिखने के बाद उसने जिला फोरम में एक केस दर्ज कर दिया।

questions.text_english:
Sara decided to purchase vegetables online from 'Desi Store' which is a popular online store. She ordered 1 kg carrots, 1 kg potatoes and 2 kg tomatoes. After receiving the order, Sara realised that the weight of the vegetables was much less than what she had ordered. On checking the website again, she found that on the website, only price of each item is stated, but the weight or quantity of the vegetables against the price is not specified.
She contacted the customer care center for her grievance. The customer care center representative simply told that weight of the vegetables varies, so it is not indicated against the price.
Sara asked the representative many times to speak to a supervisor, but every time the representative stated that no one is available. Sara was disappointed and left a review on the website and filed a case in the District Forum.
Identify and explain the two rights of the consumer discussed above.

key_points: Right to Information — consumers have the right to be informed about the quantity, quality, purity, standard, and price of goods
Right to be Heard (Right to Redressal) — consumers have the right to have their grievances heard and addressed; filing in District Forum is an exercise of this right

questions.solution: The two consumer rights discussed in the above case are as follows. First, Right to Information: Sara found that the website only mentioned the price of vegetables but did not specify the weight or quantity against the price. This violates the consumer's right to information — every consumer has the right to be informed about the quality, quantity, purity, standard, and price of goods and services so that they are not deceived. Had the weight been clearly mentioned, Sara would not have been misled about what she was purchasing. Second, Right to be Heard (Right to Seek Redressal): when Sara contacted the customer care centre to raise her grievance, the representative dismissed her concern and refused to connect her to a supervisor. This violated her right to be heard. Every consumer has the right to have their grievances listened to and addressed properly. Sara exercised this right further by writing a review on the website and filing a case in the District Forum, which is a legal platform available to consumers for seeking justice and redressal.

sub_questions.text: प्रबंध के 'नियोजन' कार्य के महत्त्व के किन्हीं चार बिन्दुओं को समझाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any four points of importance of 'Planning' function of management.

key_points: Provides direction — Planning sets clear goals and guides all activities
Reduces risk of uncertainty — Planning anticipates future events and prepares for them
Facilitates decision making — Planning provides a framework for making better decisions
Promotes innovation and creativity — Planning encourages managers to think ahead and develop new ideas

sub_questions.solution: Four points of importance of the planning function of management are as follows. First, Provides Direction: planning sets specific objectives and defines the course of action to achieve them. It gives a clear sense of direction to all employees and departments, ensuring that everyone moves toward the same organisational goals. Without planning, people would work randomly, wasting effort and resources. Second, Reduces Risk of Uncertainty: the future is unpredictable, but planning helps managers anticipate future events, assess likely changes in the environment, and prepare contingency measures. By thinking ahead, organisations can reduce the impact of uncertainty and be better prepared for challenges. Third, Facilitates Decision Making: planning provides a predefined framework of goals and strategies, which makes decision making faster and more rational. When managers face situations requiring choices, they can refer to the existing plan and decide what aligns best with the objectives. This saves time and promotes consistency. Fourth, Promotes Innovation and Creativity: planning encourages managers to look beyond the present and think creatively about the future. It stimulates original thinking, promotes new approaches to problems, and fosters innovation. Managers who engage in thorough planning are more likely to identify new opportunities and come up with novel solutions.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain any four points that highlight the importance of 'Delegation'.

key_points: Effective management — Delegation allows managers to focus on important tasks by assigning routine work to subordinates
Employee development — Delegation gives subordinates opportunities to develop their skills
Motivation — Delegation gives subordinates authority and responsibility, boosting their confidence and motivation
Basis of management hierarchy — Delegation creates the chain of authority from top to bottom

sub_questions.solution: Four points highlighting the importance of delegation are as follows. First, Effective Management: a manager cannot perform all tasks personally. By delegating routine work to subordinates, the manager can focus on more important, strategic activities. This makes management more effective and efficient, as each person handles tasks suited to their level. Second, Employee Development: delegation gives subordinates the opportunity to handle greater responsibilities, learn new skills, and gain practical experience. This contributes to their personal and professional growth and prepares them for higher roles in the future. Third, Motivation of Employees: when managers delegate authority and responsibility to their subordinates, it communicates trust and confidence in their abilities. This boosts the subordinates' motivation, morale, and job satisfaction, leading to higher productivity and commitment to the organisation. Fourth, Facilitates Organisational Growth: delegation is the foundation of the management hierarchy. It creates a chain of authority from the top to the bottom of the organisation, enabling the organisation to expand its operations. Without delegation, a manager would be unable to supervise a growing number of employees and activities, making growth impossible.

निम्नलिखित प्रत्येक स्थिति में चर्चित सम्प्रेषण बाधा को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए तथा प्रत्येक सम्प्रेषण बाधा की विस्तृत श्रेणी का नाम बताइए जिससे वह सम्बन्धित है :
(i) 'एमएनबी लिमिटेड' ने कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता (आर्टिफिशियल इन्टेलिजेन्स) का उपयोग करते हुए एक नए सॉफ्टवेयर कार्यक्रम का शुभारंभ किया। परियोजना प्रबंधक, अजीत ने संगठन के कर्मचारियों को 'क्लाउड कम्प्यूटिंग', 'मशीन लर्निंग', आदि जैसे शब्दों का प्रयोग करते हुए नया सॉफ्टवेयर सिस्टम (विधि) समझाया। चूँकि कर्मचारी इस क्षेत्र के विशेषज्ञ नहीं थे, वे परियोजना प्रबंधक द्वारा उपयोग में लाए गए बहुत से शब्दों का वास्तविक अर्थ नहीं समझ सके।
(ii) राजेश ने, जो 'केएलएम लिमिटेड' में उत्पादन प्रबंधक के रूप में कार्य कर रहा है, अपने कार्य से सम्बन्धित समस्याओं पर चर्चा करने के लिए सामान्य प्रबंधक, कुमार से सम्पर्क किया। राजेश ने उसे बढ़ते हुए कार्यभार और उसके लिए अतिरिक्त सहायता की आवश्यकता के बारे में बताया। लेकिन कुमार, जो कि एक महत्त्वपूर्ण फाइल पर कार्य कर रहा था, उस पर सरसरी नज़र डाल रहा था और कभी-कभी सिर हिला रहा था। उसने न तो एक बार भी राजेश के साथ आँखों से सम्पर्क स्थापित किया और न ही फाइल को पढ़ना बंद किया। उसने यह कहकर उत्तर दिया ''ठीक है राजेश, किसी तरह संभालने का प्रयास करो''। राजेश निराश होकर ऑफिस से चला गया।
(iii) कार के अतिरिक्त पुर्जे बनाने वाली एक कम्पनी में सुरेश एक वरिष्ठ तकनीशियन है। कार्यकुशलता को बढ़ाने के लिए उसने मशीनों पर निष्क्रिय समय को कम करने के लिए एक नई विधि का सुझाव दिया। उसने एक समूह मीटिंग के दौरान अपने विचार को प्रस्तुत किया जिसकी सभी के द्वारा प्रशंसा की गई। लेकिन प्रबंधक, पंकज ने उसके इस शानदार विचार पर कोई प्रशंसा पुरस्कार नहीं दिया।

Identify and explain the communication barrier discussed in each of the following cases and name the broad category of each communication barrier to which they relate :
(i) 'MNB Ltd.' launches a new software programme using Artificial Intelligence. Ajit, the Project Manager, explains the new software system to employees in the organisation, using terms like 'cloud computing', 'machine learning', etc. Since the employees are not specialists in this field, they cannot understand the actual meaning of many words used by the Project Manager.
(ii) Rajesh, working as Production Manager in 'KLM Ltd.', approaches the General Manager, Kumar to discuss the problems he is having at work. Rajesh tells him about the increasing workload and the need for additional support. However, Kumar who is working on an important file, keeps glancing at it while nodding occasionally. He does not make eye contact with Rajesh or stop reading the file. He responds saying "Okay Rajesh, just try to manage". Rajesh leaves the office feeling disappointed.
(iii) Suresh is a senior technician at a company manufacturing spare parts of a car. He suggests a new method for reducing the idle time on machines to increase efficiency. He presents his idea during a team meeting and is appreciated by everyone. But the manager Pankaj, does not offer any appreciation award for his brilliant idea.

sub_questions.text_english: 'MNB Ltd.' launches a new software programme using Artificial Intelligence. Ajit, the Project Manager, explains the new software system to employees using technical jargon like 'cloud computing', 'machine learning'. Employees cannot understand the actual meaning.

key_points: Barrier: Use of Technical Jargon / Semantic Barrier
Category: Semantic Barriers (barriers related to language and meaning)

sub_questions.solution: The communication barrier in this case is Use of Technical Jargon, which falls under Semantic Barriers. Semantic barriers arise due to problems with language and meaning. Ajit, the project manager, used highly technical terms like 'cloud computing' and 'machine learning' while communicating with employees who are not specialists in the field of technology. Because the employees are not familiar with this terminology, they could not understand the actual meaning of the message. This creates a communication gap. Semantic barriers occur when the sender and receiver interpret the same words differently or when the sender uses language unfamiliar to the receiver.

sub_questions.text: राजेश ने ... सामान्य प्रबंधक, कुमार से सम्पर्क किया...
sub_questions.text_english: Rajesh approaches General Manager Kumar to discuss problems. Kumar keeps glancing at a file, does not make eye contact, and responds dismissively.

key_points: Barrier: Poor Listening / Inattention (Psychological / Personal Barrier)
Category: Personal Barriers (barriers arising from personal attitudes and behaviour)

sub_questions.solution: The communication barrier in this case is Poor Listening or Inattention, which falls under Personal Barriers. Personal barriers arise due to personal attitudes, feelings, or behaviour of the communicating parties. Kumar, the General Manager, is not listening attentively to Rajesh — he keeps glancing at a file, does not make eye contact, and nods occasionally without genuinely engaging. This shows a lack of interest in listening, which is a personal barrier. Effective communication requires active listening, and when the receiver is distracted and inattentive, the message is not properly received or acted upon, leaving the sender frustrated and unheard.

key_points: Barrier: Lack of Proper Incentive / Organisational Barrier
Category: Organisational Barriers (barriers arising from the structure or policies of the organisation)

sub_questions.solution: The communication barrier in this case is Lack of Proper Incentive, which falls under Organisational Barriers. Organisational barriers arise from the rules, policies, or culture of the organisation that hinder free and effective communication. Suresh presented an innovative idea that was appreciated by everyone in the meeting, but the manager did not acknowledge it with any appreciation award or recognition. When employees do not receive proper incentive or recognition for their ideas and suggestions, they are discouraged from communicating further or contributing creatively. A lack of reward system thus acts as a barrier to upward communication and reduces employee participation.

sub_questions.text: प्रबंध के 'निर्देशन' कार्य की किन्हीं चार विशेषताओं को समझाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any four features of 'Directing' function of management.

key_points: Pervasive function — Directing is performed at all levels of management
Continuous activity — Directing is a continuous process that goes on throughout the life of the organisation
Flows from top to bottom — Direction initiates at the top level and flows downward
Human element — Directing involves dealing with people, so it is a human-oriented function

sub_questions.solution: Four features of the directing function of management are as follows. First, Pervasive Function: directing is performed at every level of management — top, middle, and lower. Every manager, regardless of their level in the hierarchy, directs their subordinates. A CEO directs departmental heads, departmental heads direct section managers, and section managers direct workers. It is therefore a universally required function across the organisation. Second, Continuous Activity: directing is not a one-time activity but a continuous and ongoing process. Managers need to constantly guide, supervise, motivate, and communicate with employees throughout the life of the organisation. Business activities never stop, so directing never stops either. Third, Flows from Top to Bottom: directing originates at the top management level and flows downward through the hierarchy. The top management gives direction to middle management, middle management directs lower management, and lower management guides workers. This ensures coordinated effort at all levels. Fourth, Human Element: directing is fundamentally concerned with people — motivating them, leading them, communicating with them, and guiding their behaviour. Since every person has different needs, attitudes, and emotions, directing requires sensitivity, understanding, and interpersonal skills. It is the most human-oriented of all management functions.

sub_questions.text: निर्देशन के एक तत्त्व के रूप में 'अभिप्रेरणा' की किन्हीं चार विशेषताओं को समझाइए।
sub_questions.text_english: Explain any four features of 'Motivation', an element of directing.

key_points: Internal feeling — Motivation is an internal psychological force that drives behaviour
Goal directed — Motivation is always directed towards achieving a specific goal
Continuous process — The need to motivate employees is continuous as human needs are never fully satisfied
Positive or negative — Motivation can be positive (rewards) or negative (fear of punishment)

sub_questions.solution: Four features of motivation as an element of directing are as follows. First, Internal Feeling: motivation is an internal psychological state or urge that drives a person to act in a particular way. It arises from within the individual based on their needs, desires, and aspirations. A manager cannot directly create motivation but can create conditions that stimulate it. Second, Goal-Directed Behaviour: motivation is always oriented towards achieving a specific objective or goal. A motivated person directs all their energy and effort towards the desired outcome. Without a clear goal, motivation becomes purposeless. Third, Continuous Process: human needs are never fully and permanently satisfied — once one need is met, another arises. Therefore, the process of motivating employees must be continuous. Managers need to keep identifying new needs and finding ways to satisfy them to sustain employee effort. Fourth, Can be Positive or Negative: motivation can take two forms — positive motivation (offering rewards, recognition, incentives) encourages desired behaviour, while negative motivation (threats, penalties, fear of punishment) discourages undesired behaviour. Positive motivation tends to produce better long-term results as it creates willingness rather than fear.
