questions.text:
'साउंड-इट' एक स्टार्टअप है और वायरलेस ईयरबड्स की एक श्रृंखला का शुभारंभ करने की योजना बना रही है। शुभारंभ करने से पूर्व, कम्पनी ने निर्णय लिया कि ऑनलाइन सर्वेक्षण तथा इंटरेक्टिव (एक-दूसरे को प्रभावित करने वाली) वेबसाइट के माध्यम से वे उपभोक्ताओं से प्रतिक्रिया एकत्रित करेंगे। इस खोज के द्वारा उन्होंने युवा, तकनीक प्रेमी, जो अच्छी गुणवत्ता वाली ध्वनि, टिकाऊपन और आराम को महत्त्व देते हैं, की अपने लक्ष्य बाज़ार के रूप में पहचान की। खोज ने यह भी दर्शाया कि उपभोक्ता लंबी बैटरी लाइफ, जल प्रतिरोधी तथा अन्य उपकरणों के साथ आसानी से जुड़ने वाले ईयरबड्स चाहते हैं।
इस सूचना का प्रयोग करते हुए, 'साउंड-इट' ने ऐसे ईयरबड्स डिज़ाइन किए जो उपभोक्ताओं की इन आवश्यकताओं को पूरा करें। ईयरबड्स नरम ईयरटिप्स के साथ सुविधाजनक हैं, इनमें शोर रद्द करने वाली उन्नत तकनीक सम्मिलित है, इनका डिज़ाइन बहुत कम भार वाला है तथा इनमें अच्छी जल प्रतिरोधी क्षमता है जो इन्हें खेलों एवं अन्य बाह्य गतिविधियों के लिए उत्तम बनाती है। डिज़ाइन न केवल साउंड (ध्वनि) व सुविधा को उत्कृष्ट बनाता है बल्कि इसे बाज़ार में प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक बढ़त भी देता है।
बहुत से घटकों जैसे उत्पादन लागत, प्रतिस्पर्धियों के मूल्य, उत्पाद की उपयोगिता एवं माँग, आदि का मूल्यांकन करने के बाद कम्पनी ने ऐसी राशि लेने का निर्णय लिया जो उसके प्रतिस्पर्धियों से कम हो ताकि वे उपभोक्ता आकर्षित हों जो अच्छी गुणवत्ता किफायती मूल्य पर चाहते हैं।
'साउंड-इट' ने अपने ईयरबड्स के बारे में, उपभोक्ताओं को सूचित करने के लिए सोशल मीडिया पर डिजिटल विज्ञापन चलाए तथा अपने ईयरबड्स पर विशेष छूट तथा मुफ्त उपहार जैसे प्रस्ताव दिए।
उपर्युक्त स्थिति में चर्चित विपणन के चार कार्यों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए।
questions.text_english:
'Sound-it' is a startup planning to launch a line of wireless earbuds. Before launching, the company decides to gather feedback from customers through online surveys and interactive websites. From this research, they identify their target market as young, tech-savvy people, who value good sound quality, durability and comfort. The research also shows that customers want earbuds with long battery life, water resistance and the ability to easily connect with other devices.
Using this information, 'Sound-it' designs earbuds that meet these needs of the customer. The earbuds are comfortable with soft eartips, include advanced noise-cancelling technology, a lightweight design and good water-resistance, making them perfect for sports and outdoor activities. The design not only improves sound and comfort, but also gives it a competitive edge in the market.
It decides to charge an amount lower than their competitors to attract customers who want good quality at an affordable price after evaluating various factors like production costs, competitor prices, the product's utility and demand, etc.
To inform the customers about its earbuds, 'Sound-it', runs digital advertisement on social media and offers special discounts and free gift offers on its earbuds.
Identify and explain the four marketing functions discussed in the above case.

key_points: Gathering and Analysing Market Information — conducting online surveys to understand customer needs
Product Design and Development — designing earbuds based on customer feedback
Pricing Decisions — deciding price lower than competitors after evaluating various factors
Promotion — running digital advertisements on social media and offering discounts and free gifts

questions.solution: Four marketing functions discussed in the above case are as follows. First, Gathering and Analysing Market Information: before launching the product, Sound-it conducted online surveys and used interactive websites to gather feedback from customers. This is the marketing function of market research — systematically collecting, recording, and analysing data about the target market, including customer needs, preferences, and desired product features. This helps the company make informed decisions about its products and strategies. Second, Product Design and Development: using the research findings, Sound-it designed earbuds with soft eartips, noise-cancelling technology, lightweight build, and water resistance. Product design and development is the marketing function that involves converting customer requirements into a tangible product with specific features, qualities, and characteristics that satisfy customer needs and give the product a competitive advantage. Third, Pricing Decisions: Sound-it decided to price its earbuds lower than competitors after evaluating production costs, competitor prices, product utility, and market demand. Pricing is a critical marketing function because the price must cover costs, be competitive in the market, and be perceived as fair value by customers. Competitive pricing helps attract price-sensitive customers looking for good quality at affordable rates. Fourth, Promotion: Sound-it ran digital advertisements on social media and offered special discounts and free gift offers. Promotion is the marketing function that involves communicating information about the product to potential customers through advertising, sales promotions, and other means, with the aim of creating awareness, generating interest, and stimulating purchase.
